rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for richly detailed or intricately complex decoration and design.

example.english: The carvings on this old castle are baroque but beautiful.
example.traditional: 呢座古堡嘅外牆雕花繁複得嚟好靚。
example.jyutping: ne1 zo6 gu2 bou2 ge3 ngoi6 coeng4 diu1 faa1 faan4 fuk1 dak1 lai4 hou2 leng3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the Western Baroque period, style, art, or music.

example.english: This baroque piece sounds solemn and magnificent.
example.traditional: 呢首巴洛克式樂曲聽落莊嚴又華麗。
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 baa1 lok3 hak1 sik1 ngok6 kuk1 teng1 lok6 zong1 jim4 jau6 waa4 lai6

rows.note: Use this when the complexity is needlessly cumbersome, especially for procedures or bureaucracy.

example.english: The application process is so baroque that I have to make several trips.
example.traditional: 申請張證件嘅手續太繁瑣，搞到我要走幾轉。
